title: Can't You See
notes: Whole song is one four-bar loop: D - C - G - D, unchanged through intro, verse, chorus and solo. In D that reads 1 - b7 - 4 - 1; the C is the non-diatonic flat-seven that gives it the southern-rock lean, the same move Box of Rain makes in the same key. Source chart states no capo. No verified bass tab recorded yet.
